note: Canonical hero registry. `classes`, `lanes` and `apiId` come from the official snapshot in data/sources/ — not from authored knowledge, because authored role data was found to be confidently wrong. `flexLanes` are lanes a hero is drafted into that the game does not list. `meta` is a 0-100 competitive priority baseline and `difficulty` a 1-5 mechanical demand; both are authored and are overridden by live rank statistics when reachable. `provenance` says which layer each row's role and lane came from.
